title: Dedicated servers
summary: KloudC masters: moving a store to its own server, only with approval, and rolling back.

blocks.text: Every store runs on **shared hosting** by default, with its own separate database. A store that needs it can move to a **dedicated server**.

items: A store admin or a master asks on the **Hosting** tab. Nothing moves without a master's approval.
It only works when dedicated hosting is switched on for the platform. While it is off, the tab says so.
The move follows the dedicated hosting runbook: approve, prepare the server, copy the database during a short read-only window at night, then **Mark moved**.
**Roll back** within 7 days moves the store back if something is wrong. You are asked why.
